checkpoint_wrapper: wrap a PyTorch nn.Module with activation checkpointing to reduce GPU memory usage during training
disable_checkpointing: use a context manager to temporarily disable activation checkpointing for a code block
is_checkpointing: check whether the current forward pass is running under activation checkpointing
is_recomputing: check whether the current forward pass is recomputing activations during the backward pass
CheckpointFunction: use a custom autograd Function to perform activation checkpointing with non-Tensor output support
